description_en: Modifies the priority of an access control policy in a policy group for a VPC firewall
description_zh: 修改指定VPC防火墙策略组访问控制策略的优先级
name: ModifyVpcFirewallControlPolicyPosition

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.

Valid values:

zh (Default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the policy group for the VPC firewall. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html operation to obtain the ID.

Valid values:

If the VPC firewall protects a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, the ID of the policy group is the ID of the CEN instance.

  Example: cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\\

If the VPC firewall protects an Express Connect circuit, the ID of the policy group is the ID of the VPC firewall instance.

  Example: vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\\
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略组ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html接口获取该ID。

取值：

VPC边界防火墙防护云企业网时，策略组ID使用云企业网实例ID。
  
   例如cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\\

VPC边界防火墙防护高速通道时，策略组ID使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

  例如vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\\
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The new priority of the access control policy.

For more information about the valid range of priorities, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/474145.html
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略优先级修改后，该策略的新优先级。
新优先级的取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/474145.html
parameters.name: new_order

parameters.help_en:
The original priority of the access control policy.

This parameter is deprecated. Use the AclUuid parameter to specify the policy to modify
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略优先级修改前，该策略的原优先级。

此参数不推荐使用, 建议使用AclUuid参数指定要修改的策略
parameters.name: old_order

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the access control policy.

To modify an access control policy, provide the unique ID of the policy. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159758.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

修改访问控制策略时，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159758.html接口获取该ID
parameters.name: acl_uuid
